title: DataFetcherConfiguration
description: Headless DGF component that fires a dataSource reactively and dispatches onValueChange events to mutate other components.

name.description: Unique camelCase identifier. Result is accessible as ${name.@data.field} from any component on the page.

dataSource.description: Inline dataSource definition. Mutually exclusive with dataSourcePath.

dataSourcePath.description: Relative path to an external JSON dataSource file. Mutually exclusive with dataSource.

debounceMs.description: Milliseconds to wait after the last parameter change before firing. null = fire immediately. Use 150–300 for combo-driven params, 300–500 for text field params.

manualTrigger.description: When true, reactive subscription is disabled. Fire only via a Button with componentAction { targetName, targetAction: "data" }.

silentOnError.description: When true, HTTP errors are logged at warn level but the global error toast is suppressed. Use for non-critical page-load fetches.

parameters.description: Parameter bindings passed to the dataSource. Use ${componentName} tokens for reactive bindings.

events.description: Event handlers dispatched after each successful fetch.

onValueChange.description: Handlers executed after a successful fetch, in order. Each handler targets a component and applies an action verb.

hidden.description: Always renders hidden — DataFetcher produces no UI. This field is informational only.

metaData.description: Arbitrary key/value metadata attached to the component configuration.

name.description: Parameter name passed to the dataSource endpoint.

value.description: Parameter value. Use ${componentName} for reactive field references, ~UserID / ~TenantID for context tokens, or a literal string.

required.description: When true, the framework skips the HTTP request if this parameter resolves to an empty or null value (ComponentFacadeService.validateRequiredParameters). Set required: true to gate the fetch on this parameter's presence.
